tasks.title: Add mode toggle icon tests to Calculator test suite
tasks.description: 1. WHAT: Add tests that verify the theme toggle button displays the correct icon (🌙 in light mode, ☀️ in dark mode) and that clicking the toggle switches the icon. 2. READ FIRST: src/components/Calculator.tsx (lines 116-138, theme-toggle button renders `{theme === 'light' ? '🌙' : '☀️'}`), src/App.tsx (ThemeContext provides theme and toggleTheme), src/components/Calculator.test.tsx (existing test structure — describe/it blocks, userEvent.setup() pattern). 3. FILES: Modify src/components/Calculator.test.tsx only — add a new describe block 'theme toggle icons' inside the top-level describe('Calculator'). 4. APPROACH: The Calculator component reads theme from ThemeContext via useContext. To test icon display, wrap the rendered Calculator in a ThemeContext.Provider with a controlled theme value. Test that: (a) in light mode the toggle button text content is '🌙', (b) in dark mode the toggle button text content is '☀️', (c) clicking the toggle button calls toggleTheme. Use `screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Toggle theme' })` to query the button (it has aria-label='Toggle theme'). Use `vi.fn()` for the toggleTheme mock. Import ThemeContext from '../App'. 5. PATTERNS: Follow the exact same describe/it/beforeEach/userEvent pattern used in the existing tests. Import ThemeContext from '../App' — it is already exported as a named export.
